messages:
olivia: quick postmortem follow-up — recurring pattern: flag ramps colliding with batch windows. sketching a small, testable plan called "safety curtains".
raj: sounds good, what are the pieces?
olivia: 1) holdback profiles (curves) + preferred_quiet_windows; 2) automatic rollback with a quiesce period to avoid thrash; 3) dependency-aware rollbacks and a DAG validator; 4) recurrence alerting to bump flag risk.
marcus: for quiesce: after an auto-rollback, controller should wait a cooldown (e.g., 15m) before any further automated action for that flag_id. prevents cascades.
sara: agree. auto-rollback config sketch: {window_s:300, error_pct:1.2, min_requests:400, action:step_back, blast_cap_pct:10, quiesce_mins:15}. prototype in 1w.
raj: will add preferred_quiet_windows and deps[] to flag schema. also add owner and risk_level. will open GH PR by EOW.
eng-sre: we can help with sampling and surfacing batch window schedule in metrics so controller can avoid those windows by default.
lina_pm: PM will track on remediation board. owners/dates: raj EOW, marcus (holdback + UI) 2w, sara prototype 1w, olivia recurrence POC 3w.
marcus: UI ask: show projected cumulative blast and a timeline that highlights quiet windows; require explicit opt-in to schedule ramp during a quiet window.
sara: simulator note: include dependent-flag scenarios. simulator should validate quiesce + dependency logic to ensure one rollback doesn't flip another.
olivia: deploy-bot please create RF-9997 and assign. we'll run weekly check-ins until items closed.
deploy-bot: [automated] created RF-9997: "safety-curtains: holdback curves, quiesce rollbacks, deps, recurrence" assigned to raj, marcus, sara, olivia. :white_check_mark:
raj: will also add a small runbook section: "when to trigger manual quarantine vs auto-rollback".
olivia: thanks all. next sync Fri 10am. update RF-9997 if you reassign. :pray:
